summary: px8my ships a browser redirect payload to a hardcoded external URL
details: The package's main file px.js is browser JavaScript whose sole behavior is to set document.title to a Chinese lure string and append a full-viewport iframe with src set to a hardcoded external URL (https://mfmz.hz-wk.cn/H.html?c=0gjr), covering the host page. The package exposes no legitimate library API; the redirect is the entire artifact. A shipped shell script update_px8my.sh rewrites the redirect domain in px.js, bumps the package version, runs npm publish, and calls https://purge.jsdelivr.net/npm/px8my/px.js to invalidate the jsDelivr CDN cache, with a comment noting curl is blocked by abuse tooling and switching to python urllib to evade. Any site that bundles this package or loads it via jsDelivr will silently redirect its visitors to the author-controlled destination, which is rotated over time via republish.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
